title: The AI Skills for an FDE Job
description:
What AI skills does a forward-deployed engineer actually need? You don't have to build your own large language model from scratch. What matters is being fluent in building with LLMs: calling model APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, vector databases, and shipping production AI systems. 

On top of that, understanding agent orchestration, multi-step workflows, evaluations, observability, and logging, everything that goes into integrating AI systems that actually work in the real world.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #techjobs
